description: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" compares the performance of four different methods: 'Ours', '-critiquing', '-scoring', and '-ranking' on the INSPIRED dataset. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 values, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists the methods. The 'Ours' method has the highest Recall@10 value, approximately 0.35, represented by an orange bar. The '-scoring' method has the lowest performance, with a value of roughly 0.12, shown by a blue bar. The '-ranking' method outperforms '-critiquing' with a Recall@10 value of approximately 0.28, compared to '-critiquing's 0.25, both represented by blue bars. The chart shows a general decline in performance from 'Ours' to '-scoring', with '-ranking' showing a slight recovery in Recall@10 values. The bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in orange and the other methods in blue.

Notably, '-ranking' consistently outperforms '-critiquing' with a Recall@10 value of approximately 0.28 compared to '-critiquing's 0.25. The chart highlights a steady decline in performance from 'Ours' to '-scoring', with '-ranking' showing a slight recovery in Recall@10 values. The vertical axis ranges from 0.1 to 0.4, and the bars are color-coded, with 'Ours' in orange and the other methods in blue.
